name: IC Sensor — I2C, 3.6V — Sensirion
description: Sensirion I2C 3.6V surface-mount humidity IC sensor cluster featuring SHT4x and SHTC3 parts in DFN-4 footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an I2C sensor rated for 3.6V in surface-mount Sensirion DFN-4 footprints.
Choose SHT4x for the 1.5x1.5mm DFN-4 footprint without a central pad.
Choose SHTC3 for the 2x2mm DFN-4-1EP footprint with an exposed pad.
avoid_when: Do not use if through-hole mounting is required.
Avoid when non-I2C communication or operating voltages other than 3.6V are required.
Do not use if the board layout requires packages other than DFN-4.
